visual_thesis: A paper claim, its code and its outputs can be checked against each other. Peer critique and reruns can expose weak claims, but file agreement does not prove experimental validity.
mechanism_metaphor: A continuous radial paper-relief commons rather than separate cards. A central open research bundle exposes three clearly distinct front leaves labeled Paper, Code and Data. Their physical paper tabs align at a shared seam. On the left a folded peer-review margin with two source-linked critique notches connects to a revised claim leaf. On the right the data leaf reaches an opened rerun sleeve containing a paired original-output shape and matching replay shape, joined by a headless comparison brace. A second, mismatched hypothesis fold is visibly withdrawn into a retracted-claim pocket, explicitly labeled Retract weak claims. Null-result leaf remains visible and labeled Null results count. Twelve meaningful roles: manuscript leaf, code leaf, data leaf, claim seam, critique margin, two critique notches with distinct geometry, revised leaf, original output, replay output, comparison brace, withdrawal fold and null leaf. Abstract shapes encode compared artifacts, never measured quantities or code text. No people, lab buildings, robot agents, fake writing or numeric graph.

A model-processing segment feeds a result specimen; under it lie a folded retry segment, a review-time band, and a recovery segment. The resulting completed-work specimen is larger because it contains those cost categories, not because of an invented measured ratio. The object remains continuous via two thin headless alignment pins. A small detached publisher-claim sample at upper right is clearly labeled Vendor benchmarks and has no graph, price, badge or score. Twelve meaningful parts: fixed task leaf, acceptance stencil, input aperture, model layer, output specimen, retry fold, review band, recovery layer, completed-task assembly, two alignment pins, and detached claim sample. Each cost-bearing stratum has its specific label; no opaque blank cost ledger, fake currency or numeric measurements. One causal arrow from same-task specimen port to the task-test aperture; no other arrowheads.

visual_thesis: Session identity, tool scope and a durable journal are distinct controls. A journal lets another runtime resume the same history; host-owned tools and approvals still govern actions.
mechanism_metaphor: One upright translucent session envelope cut open to expose separate identity leaf, state stack, tool rail and external journal spine. The journal front has three explicit large terms Messages, Tool calls and Results, each on its own substantial visible layer, not tiny fake log lines. A restarted-runtime socket at lower right receives the same journal spine; its coupling is labeled Resume history and does not connect to another tenant. An unpassed approval partition separates the tool rail from any side effect. An adjacent tenant silhouette stays separated by a clear air gap with no path between tenants. Twelve meaningful parts: session envelope, identity leaf, state stack, tool rail, three journal layers, persisted spine, resumed-runtime socket, approval partition, tenant separation and detached scope qualifier. One arrow only: journal spine port to resumed-runtime socket. Headless thin ties associate the identity and tools with the same session. No security shield, guarantee mark, avatars, code, fake log strokes, invented metrics or universal approval guarantee. Approval shown as application-owned policy, not automatic for every architecture.
story_anchors: Bounded session identity, tools and detached host-policy caveat
